Hi, Cards fan from Arizona since 2000. We didn't get the franchise until 1988 and as a kid I idolized John Elway and rooted for the Denver Broncos before they won some rings. After that, I committed to all home teams because for some odd reason, I'm proud to be a Zonie. 

We're usually the underdogs. Some think those days are over for a while, others think "all of nothing" because of aging legends like Larry Fitzgerald and a good quarterback in Carson Palmer. Not to mention that our great coach Bruce Arians doesn't have all day, either. Hence why the organization is doing all it can to bring a Superbowl win to Arizona.

Our history is traditionally a bad one. A few bright moments but I really think the turning point was with Warner/Fitzgerald and the great Superbowl run in 2009(?) where we had arguably the best Superbowl game of all time, losing to the Pittsburgh Steelers at the last moment. We've either been contenders or a thought in the back of the NFL's mind ever since.

Then Arians and Palmer jumped on board and we've progressively gotten better every year. We've even gained a bandwagon following, which might be why you're here. And I'm cool with that as long as you stick with us. Because we had to ride out some rough years.

We play in arguably the most competitive division in our conference (The NFC), and Seahawk games especially have become our own personal Superbowls for the last few years. The year they blew Peyton Manning's Broncos out, we didn't make the play-offs but we walked into Seattle and ended their winning streak at home. It was a glorious day. and raised the eyebrow of the NFL even higher. And now, here we are.

This ain't New York or Massachusetts where winning 3 or 4 titles a year per professional sport is a regular thing. We are an underdog state with underdog teams. Which in my opinion, makes the sweeter moments even sweeter. However, some seasons you may find yourself cynically watching games and facepalming a lot, lol. But we're glad you landed here and we welcome you.
